verdict.rationale: Windmill documents per-step retries in flows: on error, a step is retried with a delay up to a maximum number of attempts. This covers automatic retries for failed steps, but the evidence only mentions a delay, not an increasing or exponential backoff strategy. missing for 10: explicit documented exponential/backoff configuration, retry configuration for workflows-as-code activities, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure automatic retries with backoff for failed steps or activities

citations.quote: If defined, upon error this step will be retried with a delay and a maximum number of attempts as defined below.
